📅 WORK SCHEDULE

Upload and manage employee shifts · Tap to request time off

This Week's Schedule
Loading the schedule…
Every day has two slots. A name in grey marked (covering) means nobody is rostered for that slot, so the Manager has it.
Upload Master Schedule
📄
Tap to upload a schedule
JSON, CSV or PDF · months at a time · 8am-3pm & 3pm-10pm
What should the file look like?
Six columns, one row per calendar day:
Employee | Day | Date | Start | End | Shift

Deashinique  Sunday  Aug 09, 2026  3:00pm  10:00pm  Night
Deashinique  Monday  Aug 10, 2026  -  -  OFF

Dates as Aug 09, 2026 or 2026-08-09. Times as 8:00am / 3:00pm (24-hour is fine too).
A day off is written OFF with - for Start and End — the Manager then covers both slots that day.

Whether a row is the morning or the evening slot is decided by its start time, not by the word in the Shift column.

JSON instead: {"staff":"Deashinique","period_start":"2026-08-09", "period_end":"2026-10-10","shifts":[ {"date":"2026-08-09","staff":"Deashinique", "start":"15:00","end":"22:00","shift":"Night"}]}
Importing only replaces those people's shifts between the first and last date in the file — nothing outside that stretch, and nobody else's rows, are touched.
Or Enter Shifts Manually
